source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 湖亭焚香石壁歌
title: 湖亭焚香，石壁旧歌
purpose: 拓拔野循箫声来到湖边小亭，发现焚香犹在却空无一人；随后认出石壁上的旧歌与神农有关，情绪转入怀念与回应。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 uses the previous bamboo-wall storyboard for continuity. SH02 uses the Yuping/Tianhu location reference for pavilion mood. SH03 uses Tuobaye or location reference but forbids readable wall text. SH04 uses Tuobaye turnaround to lock flute/costume.
video_policy: Gemini experimental I2V should use only each generated and approved storyboard image as source of truth. No extra character or location references in video generation.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, calligraphy, legible wall characters, or English words inside image/video.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue or flute audio. Chinese narration, flute/xiao sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 这歌……是神农前辈昨日唱过的。
若你听得见，就让我替你吹完。
